# ClawSteps

> Premier, certified dog walking and pet care service based in Delhi NCR, India.

## About & Brand Mission
ClawSteps provides safe, structured daily walks, behavioral stimulation, and personalized pet care for apartment and working pet parents. Every walker undergoes identity verification, criminal background checks, and training in canine body language, pack management, and pet first-aid.

---

## Core Services & Pricing Structure
- **Quick Relief Walk (20 Mins):** Designed for puppies, senior dogs, and brachycephalic breeds (Pugs, Shih Tzus). Focuses on bladder relief, gentle pace, and basic hydration.
- **Standard Exercise Walk (30 Mins):** Ideal for Beagles, Indie dogs, and Cocker Spaniels. Includes loose-leash training, scent exploration, and exercise.
- **Power Cardio Walk (40 Mins):** High-energy burn for Labradors, Golden Retrievers, German Shepherds, and Huskies. Focuses on cardio conditioning and anxiety reduction.
- **Home Dog Boarding (Cage-Free):** Safe, family-style domestic boarding environment with 24/7 human supervision and regular routine meals.
- **Price Range:** Walking packages start from ₹299 per session. Monthly subscription tiers are available across 5-day and 7-day weekly schedules.

---

## Service Areas & Local Availability
ClawSteps provides on-demand and daily recurring services across Delhi NCR, including:
- **West Delhi:** Dwarka (All Sectors 1 to 24), Mohan Garden, Nawada, Uttam Nagar, Janakpuri, Vikaspuri.
- **South Delhi:** Vasant Kunj, Saket, Hauz Khas, Greater Kailash (GK), Defence Colony.
- **Noida & Greater Noida:** Sectors 18, 50, 62, 75, 76, 137, Expressway societies.
- **Gurgaon (Gurugram):** DLF Phase 1-5, Golf Course Road, Cyber City, Sector 48, Sector 56.

---

## Safety, Trust & Operations
- **Live GPS & Updates:** Real-time walk tracking sent via WhatsApp alongside route distance, duration, and potty logs.
- **Equipment Policy:** Harness-only walking policy. Strict prohibition of choke chains, prong collars, or punitive handling.
- **Operating Hours:** Monday to Sunday, 10:00 AM – 07:00 PM IST.
- **First Walk Policy:** Complimentary 100% Free Meet & Greet / Trial session prior to paid plan activation.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Q: Are ClawSteps dog walkers background-verified?**
  A: Yes, all handlers are police-verified, identity-authenticated, and certified in safe handling practices.
- **Q: How does the free trial work?**
  A: A handler visits your home to meet your pup, test leash comfort, and understand specific temperamental needs without cost.
- **Q: What happens during extreme weather (Delhi heat/rain)?**
  A: Walk timings shift to early mornings (06:00 AM) or late evenings to prevent asphalt paw burns. Indoor brain enrichment games replace outdoor walks during heavy rain or severe smog.
